name: theme-wallpaper-win
description: Box theming (Windows): sets a machine-wide desktop wallpaper via the group-policy registry values (HKLM Policies\System Wallpaper/WallpaperStyle), which every interactive user inherits. Reads $WALLPAPER_FILENAME, the attachment nakon places in this step's working directory; copies it under C:\ProgramData\huitz-theme. Auto-created idempotently by boxbuilder/vulndb.py; do not hand-edit the name.
script:
if (-not $WALLPAPER_FILENAME) { Write-Output 'WALLPAPER_FILENAME not set; nothing to do'; exit 0 }
$src = Join-Path (Get-Location) $WALLPAPER_FILENAME
if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { throw "wallpaper attachment $src not found in the working directory" }
$destDir = 'C:\ProgramData\huitz-theme'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destDir | Out-Null
$dest = Join-Path $destDir $WALLPAPER_FILENAME
Copy-Item -Force $src $dest
$k = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey('SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System', $true)
$k.SetValue('Wallpaper', $dest, 'String')
$k.SetValue('WallpaperStyle', '2', 'String')
$k.Close()
